regimeSub: August NFP blows out at 162K vs. consensus; 10Y holds 4.77% as September hike odds firm.
themes: August NFP surprise +162K vs ~100K estimate (CNBC/Reuters Sep 4) → unemployment steady 4.1%; removes labor market excuse for Fed pause; Warsh's Jackson Hole hawkish stance validated as Waller's hesitancy fades; September hike now live

10Y yield at 4.77% (-2bp from 4.79%) remains 19-month high → real rate squeeze intensifies with CPI at 3.3% YoY; Treasury selloff narrative (WSJ) persists despite modest Friday relief; 2s10s at +43bp signals term premium repricing

Brent crude at $96.28 (flat) as Iran interim peace deal (Jun 14) fails to fully normalize supply → OPEC+ production expansion (Jul 6) offset by persistent Gulf risk premium; energy drag on CPI relief extends hawkish Fed case

BOK decoupling continues post back-to-back hikes (Aug 26-27) → KRW firms to 1346 from 1355 as 3.3% growth forecast supports won; KOSPI dips to 6899 (-9pts) on Samsung/SK Hynix pullback but HBM structural bid intact

headline: August NFP blowout (+162K) validates Warsh hawkish stance as 10Y yield holds near 19-month highs, cementing September FOMC hike as base case while Brent at $96 and CPI 3.3% keep stagflation regime intact.
